description: One JSON tfvars-style file. This is a private adapter input, not an SDL extension or an authorization to install an adapter.

foothold_service_account.description: The account_id of one account already created by the source. The adapter issues and removes a key for it; it must not add an account or grant.

principal_map.description: All outside placeholders are required. Values must also be pairwise distinct; the adapter must enforce that invariant before effects.

secret_values.description: Keys are exact native secret IDs. An absent key uses synthetic-range-secret, as in the Terraform lookup. No client values belong in the repository.

title: KONTAKTE client inputs (design contract)
